correctness.rationale: The projection center and vertex lengths yield R²=1-min U_i². The planar relation among the projected e_i gives N=4 iff the largest absolute normal coordinate is at least the sum of the others, modulo zero-area boundaries. Ordered-spherical disintegration gives exact dt dphi Jacobian and joint angular widths. Differentiation establishes the cutoff, strict conditional likelihood-ratio ordering, four endpoint constants, and the opposing CDF second-derivative jumps. The joint CDF sums to the independently derived spherical minimum-coordinate CDF. The packaged checker tested 2,400 direct hulls, 600,000 normals and 48 stochastic-ordering thresholds. All infinite assertions follow from analytic steps, not simulations.

value.rationale: For a canonical three-dimensional regular polytope, it quantitatively couples projection shape class (quadrilateral versus hexagon) and geometric size (circumradius). The exact conditional law identifies different attainable supports, strict geometric stochastic order, and a linear versus square-root extreme-tail transition invisible from the known scalar silhouette frequency or unconditional radius marginal. The exact second-derivative cancellation explains a hidden phase transition, making the result a motivated structural integral-geometric theorem.
